snippet.title: Goddess of Strategy Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Lead mortal heroes on grid-based tactical maps and restore the power of the Olympians. 
Forge bonds with gods, gain divine blessings, and craft ever evolving skill synergies. 
Face limited resources, hard choices, and tactical challenges on your journey to defeat the seven deadly sins.

Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4184410/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer
Join the Discord: 
https://discord.gg/UZZjqyHRPf
Follow for updates: 
https://x.com/LostGraceGames
@lostgracegames.bsky.social

Press / business: contact@lostgracegames.at

Music by: Philipp Hackl
Trailer edit by: Gerold Brunner
Narration by: Nadia Marshall as Athena
